recommendation: Keep the audit commit as-is. Treat future date/period search semantic refinements as part of the later date-search issue family rather than re-opening the completed prefix-addition decision.
issue_request: Published/Persuasive with Modification FHIR-I issue raised against DSTU1 asking for additional date prefixes to find period-valued resources that start after or end before a date; the resolution was to add the capability using the new syntax agreed in Paris.
initial_application: Jira comments cite SVN revisions 6216 and 6217, represented in git by a6729b2c4c19162697829b45f1be532fa780badd and 2f1c3bc400b2f854c0134237237fa042d06702ea. Those commits updated source/search.html and source/search_filter.html for #6257 and implemented the accepted syntax as sa (starts after) and eb (ends before), not the originally proposed !< and !> token forms.
additional_context: Current search.html defines sa and eb, includes them in the range matrix and date examples, while search_filter.html lists the same operators and links to the prefix rules. SearchParameter.comparator is bound to SearchComparator, whose active complete CodeSystem includes sa and eb. Later date-search discussions and related audits refined period/range wording but did not reverse the FHIR-6257 prefix addition; a 2016 Zulip thread identified an old sa/eb range-wording reversal that current source has corrected.
reconciliation: Published an empty no-change audit commit because the current build source already carries FHIR-6257 across the narrative, _filter operator table, SearchParameter comparator surface, and comparator terminology source. No source edit is needed and adding the old symbolic negated operators would conflict with the historical Persuasive with Modification application.
